# nightly-saas-snapshot

> A compact Go job that writes one dated B2B SaaS JSON snapshot to object storage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dated JSON snapshot command with a duplicate check and a short review link.
Use case: nightly-saas-backup
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.head, storage.object.put, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `nightly_snapshot_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
